checks.what: the first version's cells, recomputed, equal fa4.json's (SHA-256 of their JSON)
every first-version cell in these files is found again by the rule

definition.analysis: Exact (Clopper-Pearson) intervals wherever a bootstrap collapsed: Study 1b om@6 pieces; top-up main-om pieces; C10 Opus pieces; item 7 Opus per-piece; length-sweep Opus-medium at 6 and 16 steps and its q; Study 1's 3-try Haiku-max vote on chains; Study 1b's Haiku-max vote@10 on pieces; thinking-off chains at 16 steps.
definition.inputs: the keys named, in the three analysis files, groupc.json and the length-sweep file
definition.why: The approved style sheet requires it; a [100, 100] band suggests false certainty.

label: post hoc (D-131): reported as a result labelled post hoc, never as a test; it cannot change a pre-registered reading

revision.why: fa4.json covered a hand list of 13 collapsed cells; the definition reads 'wherever a bootstrap collapsed', so revision 2 takes every zero-width interval in the stamped result files by rule (Jarvis, 2026-10-15, under D-131), keeping the first version's cells unchanged
